sells.reason: Two-legged thesis now both gone: (1) Q1 2026 earnings beat catalyst is 13 days old — only +1.26% follow-through, momentum fully spent; (2) the buy brain explicitly cited 'Iran-driven LPG trade route reshuffling as a structural tailwind for U.S.-oriented shippers' — web search confirms US-Iran peace deal announced ~June 15-19 is reopening the Strait of Hormuz, which was closed for 3+ months.
